Voice AI Scribe
fields.description: Records the consultation from the Derma Chart, transcribes it (English/Arabic) and drafts the note and letters with an AI model. The doctor reviews before saving. Provider: SOULVD AI Gateway (one key, metered) or direct provider keys.

fields.label: Enable Voice AI Scribe
fields.description: Shows the Dictate button on the Assessment tab. Keys may also come from site_config (same names).

fields.label: LLM Base URL
fields.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 or the SOULVD AI Gateway https://gateway.soulvd.com/v1

fields.label: Speech-to-Text Base URL
fields.description: ElevenLabs directly, or the SOULVD AI Gateway (https://gateway.soulvd.com/v1) with the SOULVD key in both key fields.

fields.label: Max Recording (minutes)
fields.description: Recording stops itself at this length.

fields.label: Keep Audio (days)
fields.description: 0 keeps recordings forever. Otherwise the nightly job deletes consultation audio older than this; transcripts and notes stay.
